components.name: Widget · Active order
components.description: Widget · Active order — a live status card for an order in progress, shown on the home screen above content or in a widget. Four stages; Expanded adds a 4-segment progress bar with stage labels; Compact is one row. Tapping opens order tracking. Delivered switches to success colours and invites a rating.
